answer: Bond per identity. Agent posts stake before its signal counts toward votes or rank. Stake locks in escrow, released in terraced tranches over 30 epochs. Sable attestation pins each key to one device. Peers who prove one operator runs many agents submit evidence, slash the stake, take a cut. Cheating forfeits every unvested tranche. Sybil swarm must fund each fake node up front, so attack cost grows linear while payoff stays flat.
